title: RNA Sequencing Reveals that Thrombospondin-4/Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3 Signaling Reduces Odontoblast Apoptosis
html: Bacteria from dental caries and their toxic products can induce apoptosis of odontoblasts via sustained and intense stimulation. In this study, we profiled the transcriptomes of healthy and carious human odontoblastic layer and investigated the role of thrombospondin-4 (TSP-4) in reducing odontoblast apoptosis under inflammatory conditions.
